headline: Switch 2 sales drop after price hike, Nintendo rules out another
summary: Nintendo reported Switch 2 sales dropped sharply year over year after a price increase, though overall profit rose, and investors are pressing for more big games. Nintendo's president said the company is not planning another price hike, after an earlier $50 increase brought the console's starting price to $499.

claims.statement: Switch 2 sales declined significantly year over year, attributed to the price increase.

sources.quote: Switch 2 sales fell by almost 40 percent after Nintendo increased prices
Nintendo Switch 2 sales dropped by 41% from last year due to console's price increase

claims.statement: Nintendo's overall profit rose despite the console sales drop.

sources.quote: Nintendo reports higher profit but substantially lower Switch 2 sales

claims.statement: An earlier $50 price hike brought the Switch 2's starting price to $499.

sources.quote: The Switch 2 got a $50 price hike earlier this year, bringing its starting price up to $499.
